characters.name: JUKU
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss. Heledate juustega, siniste silmadega, kandmas lühikesi siniseid pükse ja rohelist T-särki. Sõbralik ja rõõmsameelne näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: MARI
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk. Pruunide patsidega, pruunide silmadega, kandmas kollast kleiti ja punaseid sandaale. Naeratav ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Päikeseline aed
locations.description: Large, sunny garden with vibrant green grass, tall green trees, and colorful bushes in the background. A bright clear blue sky. A few small, scattered, smooth stones and thin twigs on the grass. Inviting and cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Hubane mängutuba
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom with light blue walls, a soft yellow rug covering most of the wooden floor, and a small round wooden table in the center. A red bookshelf filled with colorful children's books is on the left wall. Sunlight streams from a large window on the back wall. Plain walls, no other decorations. Cheerful and inviting atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Juku and Mari are standing in the sunny garden, smiling at each other. They are surrounded by vibrant green grass and tall trees. A clear blue sky is visible above. They are wearing their usual clothes. Cartoon style.

Juku and Mari are looking at each other excitedly in the sunny garden. They have a thoughtful, playful look, as if they just had a fun idea. The vibrant green grass and colorful bushes are in the background. Cartoon style.

Juku is kneeling on the vibrant green grass in the sunny garden, carefully picking up a thin, brown stick. Mari is standing nearby, watching him with a curious smile. Tall trees are in the background. Cartoon style.

Mari is kneeling on the vibrant green grass in the sunny garden, carefully selecting a smooth, grey stone from the ground. Juku is standing close, holding a stick he found earlier. The clear blue sky is visible. Cartoon style.

Juku and Mari are both looking at a large, bright green leaf on a colorful bush in the sunny garden. Mari is reaching out to gently pick the leaf. Juku is holding his stick and Mari has her stone. Cartoon style.

Juku is holding several thin sticks in one hand and Mari is holding a few smooth stones and a bright green leaf in her hands. They are standing together on the vibrant green grass in the sunny garden, smiling proudly at their collected items. Cartoon style.

Juku and Mari are walking hand-in-hand towards a simple wooden house door, which is framed by colorful bushes in the sunny garden. They are carrying their collected sticks, stones, and leaves. They look excited to go inside. Cartoon style.

Juku and Mari are standing just inside the cozy playroom, looking around the room. Their collected sticks, stones, and leaves are in Mari's hands. The light blue walls, yellow rug, and round wooden table are visible. Sunlight streams through the large window on the back wall. Cartoon style.

Juku and Mari are sitting on small wooden chairs at the round wooden table in the cozy playroom. The sticks, stones, and leaves are on the table. Juku is gently tapping two sticks together. Mari is holding a stone and a leaf, tapping the stone on the table. They are both smiling, making happy sounds. Sunlight fills the room. Cartoon style.

Juku and Mari are sitting at the round wooden table, surrounded by their 'instruments' (sticks, stones, leaves). They are looking at each other with wide, joyful smiles. Their eyes sparkle with happiness, and the cozy playroom feels filled with cheerful sounds. The red bookshelf is visible in the background. Cartoon style.
